Form Helvetica refers to PDF Base14; no proprietary Helvetica program is bundled.
ReportLab, Pillow, fonttools, Typst and LibreOffice are authoring tools, not new
application runtime or normal test/CI dependencies. Inert example.invalid URIs
are deliberately retained metadata; no test or generator follows them.
